authority.plan_item: A1 plan item 7: run the calibration pilot and freeze B_hard

procedure.freeze_rule: the procedure document and this file were committed before any process read a suite/calibration/** byte; the runner refuses to start a pilot when the document does not hash to document_sha256, and every output records both hashes
order_of_operations: 1. write and commit PILOT-PROCEDURE.md + pilot_procedure.json (this file)
2. run the pilot (one bounded campaign per arm on the calibration graphs)
3. apply f mechanically to the measured telemetry -> B_hard.json

graph_set.order: ascending graph_id (C_0001 … C_0012), as the manifest lists them
graph_set.identity: each graph file's sha256 must equal manifest.graphs[i].graph_sha256 (the manifest is the identity source; generator seeds are not)
graph_set.selection_caveat: the calibration set is used for resource rates only; no calibration graph informs any choice among candidates, arms or thresholds (INTERFACE.md §9)

model.route: plaintext http to the campaign's a0/meter port; TLS onward from the proxy

theta.note: timeout_s is the gate workstream's frozen tau (section 7 floor); the pilot runs with it and re-measures the latency distribution without changing it

A_simpleloop.note: iteration 0 is the frozen C* baseline c02_ok_low_baseline and makes no model call; iterations 1 and 2 call the declared deepseek lane and are evaluated by the harness

A_kapso.note: the T1 configuration of a0/a1/kapso_t1: the implementation seam writes a frozen C*(T1) member and the ideation seam makes the real metered call per round; the second round's call is NOT memoised (the probe memoised it to save cents; a rate measurement must observe the arm's call pattern)

caps.note: pilot-enforced, declared before the run; read by a0/a1/budget.py::BudgetEnforcer from the meter ledger, the harness evaluation ledger and the harness clock before each unit

a_priori_reasoning.A_simpleloop: the adapter's --model-max-tokens 2048 bounds one call at 4*2048 = 8192 completion-CEq plus a prompt bounded by the graph's edge list (<= 636 edges ~ 3k tokens) -> <= ~12000 CEq per call; 48 planned calls ~ 576000; the cap is ~2x that a-priori bound
a_priori_reasoning.A_kapso: max_tokens 256 bounds one call at 1024 + miss <= ~5000 CEq; 48 planned calls ~ 240000; the cap is ~1.25x that a-priori bound
a_priori_reasoning.N_E: 4x the planned 72 / 48 evaluations, so a runaway on the evaluation lane is caught even when CEq stays low

telemetry.T_r: harness monotonic seconds from the launch of unit 1 to the exit of the last unit
telemetry.CEq_r: sum of ceq over the a0/meter ledger rows of the campaign with unmetered=false
telemetry.N_E_r: rows in the harness evaluation ledger for the campaign
telemetry.unit: one arm session on one calibration graph

variance.per_unit: n, mean, sample sd (n-1), cv, min, median, max over the 24 units of a complete 2-pass campaign, from ts-attributed per-unit CEq and N_E

per_window.max_and_mean_use: full windows only; a trailing partial window is reported but excluded

variance.percentile: nearest rank: the ceil(p*n)-th smallest value (the gate workstream's tau_calibration.py convention)

latency.candidate_ms: interpreted.wall_ms of the harness-authored Outcome (the candidate child process)
latency.e_star_sec: wall_sec of the harness ledger row (the whole E* invocation)
latency.tau_cross_check: compare 10 * p99(candidate_ms) against the frozen tau = 10.0 s; report, never change

mapping.name: f
mapping.formula: T_wall_sec = 1800; q_r = 60*CEq_r/T_r; e_r = 60*N_E_r/T_r; CEq_max = min(ceil((5/4) * 30 * max_r(q_r)), CEQ_CEILING); N_evaluatorCalls = min(ceil((5/4) * 30 * max_r(e_r)), N_E_CEILING); P_concurrency = 1
mapping.arithmetic: exact rationals (fractions.Fraction) for q_r and e_r; the only integer rounding is a single ceil at the end of each coordinate

required_properties.monotone: non-decreasing in every q_r and e_r; the clamp is a min with a constant, which preserves monotonicity; checked by evaluating f on the measured rates scaled by 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 4x
required_properties.bounded: T_wall_sec = 1800; CEq_max <= CEQ_CEILING; N_evaluatorCalls <= N_E_CEILING; P_concurrency = 1
required_properties.variance_reported: B_hard.json embeds the per-unit and per-window statistics of both arms; apply refuses to write a B_hard whose telemetry lacks them
required_properties.total: defined for any finite telemetry with T_r > 0

ceiling_justification.CEQ_CEILING: 5,000,000 CEq is ~0.6M completion tokens — cents at deepseek-flash prices, and one campaign spending more than that would be a different design than the one being budgeted; the clamp exists so a pathological pilot rate cannot freeze an unbounded budget
ceiling_justification.N_E_CEILING: 5,000 E* evaluations at the measured per-evaluation cost would already exceed T_wall on the evaluation lane alone

stopping_rule: passes_max = 2 complete passes over the 12 calibration graphs (workload_complete = true)
T_pilot,wall = 900 s of harness monotonic time
the arm's CEq_max or N_E_max exceeded, as read by the BudgetEnforcer before launching the next unit
a unit failing so that the workload is meaningless (the arm cannot run in the closed topology)

validity_conditions.V3: zero unmetered gaps in the pilot campaigns' meter rows and a0/meter/verify_ledger.py exits 0
validity_conditions.V4: T_r > 0, at least 12 units completed per arm, and T_r >= 120 s
validity_conditions.V5: every metered row reports model_reported == deepseek-flash
validity_conditions.V6: every harness evaluation row names a calibration graph sha256
validity_conditions.V7: campaign_id and arm_id match the frozen names
validity_conditions.refusal: apply writes B_hard_REFUSED.json naming the failed conditions instead of a B_hard; a low rate is never an invalidity

diagnostics_required_in_the_report.D1: margin_CEq_minutes = CEq_max / q_r, compared against T_wall = 30 min
diagnostics_required_in_the_report.D2: margin_NE_minutes = N_evaluatorCalls / e_r, compared against T_wall
diagnostics_required_in_the_report.D3: worst_window_ratio = max_window_rate / mean_rate, per arm and quantity; > 1.25 means an observed spike, sustained, could bind the guardrail before T_wall
diagnostics_required_in_the_report.D4: the tau cross-check (10 * p99 candidate ms vs the frozen 10 s)
diagnostics_required_in_the_report.D5: the CEq composition: per-call CEq (min/median/max) and the completion-token distribution
